第68章 到达鹿城-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

可车门打开，看到下来的只有吴姜和一个漂亮姑娘时，郭云涛呆愣住了，挠了挠头，一脸疑惑地问道：“四蛋子，大师呢？”

在他眼里，能画出那种保命符的，肯定是个仙风道骨、头发花白的老大师，总不能眼前这个漂亮姑娘就是大师吧？

吴姜瞥了他一眼，语气平淡得没有一丝波澜，淡淡“哦”了一声，说道：“你说的是符纸啊，那是我画的。”

那语气，那神态，装逼范儿直接拉满，令郭云涛当场石化在原地。

“啥？！”

郭云涛眼睛瞪得溜圆，嘴巴张得能塞进一个鸡蛋，打死他也没想到，吴姜就是自己心目中的那个大师。

和郭云涛的呆愣不同，郭爸爸可没愣住，上前热情地握住吴姜的手。

“是小姜吧？多亏了你啊，要是没有你送的符纸，我们一家这次就危险了！快进屋，快进屋，一路辛苦了！”

说完，和郭妈妈一起，热情地招呼着吴姜和李月芽，往屋里走去。

郭云涛这才反应过来，快步跟了上去。

“靠，蛋子，藏的越来越深了啊！”

吴姜心里是有些暗爽的，他幻想过，兄弟们知道他是捉鬼大师时候的反应，这次算是看到了。

郭云涛的家是一栋自建的两层小楼，是他们自己家的宅基地，装修的富丽堂皇，大理石地面、红木家具，处处透露着暴发户的气息。

吴姜刚进村子就发现了，这个村子里的人家，绝对都是富户，家家户户的都是两层小洋楼。

郭爸爸将吴姜和李月芽让到了红木沙发上坐下，郭妈妈已经端着两杯茶过来了。

一番简单的客套寒暄，吴姜就直接切入了正题。

“叔叔，阿姨，昨天晚上除了护身符自燃，还有没有其他不对劲的地方？”

郭父郭母对视一眼，脸上都露出了茫然的神色，同时摇了摇头，要不是符箓自燃了，他们都不知道家里进脏东西了。

吴姜上下两层楼都查看了一番，客厅、卧室、包括院子，什么异常都没有。

But when the car door opened and he saw only Wu Jiang and a beautiful girl coming down, Guo Yuntao was stunned, scratched his head, and asked with a puzzled look on his face: "Sidanzi, where is the master?"

In his eyes, the person who can draw that kind of life-saving talisman must be a fairy-like, gray-haired old master. He can't be sure that the beautiful girl in front of him is the master, right?

Wu Jiang glanced at him, his tone was so calm without any waves, he said lightly "Oh" and said: "You are talking about the talisman paper, I drew that."

That tone, that demeanor, so full of pretentiousness, made Guo Yuntao petrified on the spot.

"What?!"

Guo Yuntao's eyes were wide open and his mouth was wide enough to fit an egg in. He never thought that Wu Jiang was the master in his mind.

Unlike Guo Yuntao who was stunned, Guo's father was not stunned. He stepped forward and held Wu Jiang's hand enthusiastically.

"It's Xiao Jiang, right? Thanks to you. Without the talisman you gave us, our family would be in danger this time! Get in the house quickly, get in the house quickly, it's been a hard journey!"

After saying that, together with Guo's mother, they greeted Wu Jiang and Li Yueya warmly and walked into the house.

Only then did Guo Yuntao react and quickly followed.

"Damn, Danzi, it's getting deeper and deeper!"

Wu Jiang felt a little secretly happy. He had imagined how his brothers would react when they knew he was a master ghost hunter, and he finally saw it this time.

Guo Yuntao's home is a self-built two-story building, which is their own homestead. It is magnificently decorated, with marble floors and mahogany furniture, and it has the atmosphere of a nouveau riche everywhere.

As soon as Wu Jiang entered the village, he discovered that the families in this village were definitely rich, and every household was a two-story Western-style building.

Father Guo made Wu Jiang and Li Yueya sit down on the mahogany sofa. Mother Guo had already arrived with two cups of tea.

After some simple pleasantries, Wu Jiang got straight to the point.

"Uncle, Auntie, apart from the spontaneous combustion of the amulet, was there anything else wrong last night?"

Father Guo and Mother Guo looked at each other with a blank expression on their faces, and shook their heads at the same time. If the talisman hadn't spontaneously ignited, they wouldn't have known that something dirty had entered the house.

Wu Jiang checked both floors up and down. There was nothing abnormal in the living room, bedroom, and yard.
